snippet.title: Tr4sh Rebuffed Trailer (Smash Ultimate Mod Direct)
snippet.description:
Tr4sh Rebuffed trailer for the Purple Enjoyers' Smash Ultimate Mod Direct. Please note that I did not make this video; the clips were collected by Meli and the video was edited by AKA7. It is uploaded to my channel as it is the one mostly associated with Tr4sh.

Join the TR4SH discord server here:
https://discord.gg/Bh7pTDf

you can download tr4sh from the discord server :)
